notes.title: Dev Log #1
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45244414/4742e4240da71d43826d81624f9e6082b25fb236.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hi, I am Aimy, and I’m here to tell you about the very first dev log![/b][/p][p][/p][h2]New Feature: [/h2][h3]Expanded Localization[/h3][p]Now the game can be played in English and Portuguese![/p][p][/p][h3]New Visual Effects[/h3][p]The new VFXs were implemented after your feedback.  Dive into the visuals![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]This is the end of today's Dev Log, and we will be back with the following Dev Log soon.[/b][/p][p][/p]
